item.title: Alert officer stopped to find Bjorn alone on the side of the road in carrier
item.description: Late last week, an officer from the Waukegan Police Animal Control near Riverwood, Illinois, found adoptable Bjorn. An unknown person had left him in a carrier on the side of the road. The temperature was below freezing, and Bjorn remained in his carrier. He was cold, lonely and undoubtedly scared.
